notes: DiscoFlate v3.26.0 — competition endings are now an ACTION BLOCK (Winner reward actions): fire [winner_score] to the pump, hand the winner a one-press Winner Button (runs its own mini-block, optional freeze + deadline), award_prize a command, or command_gate everyone else. New action types winner_button + command_gate (block_all_custom incl. roll / remove_block). Fire actions can pump until N% added or reached, block others while pumping, and run Post-Pump Actions when done. New placeholders [runnerup]/[runnerup_score], [session_leader]/[session_leader_score], [bonus_holders]. Per-range 'Allow Prize Commands' + 'Only' gates. Roll-offs can 'Add ALL player totals to the timer'. Legacy competition awards auto-migrate.
